scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:game-night: rm -rf .game-night-test-dist && esbuild src/game-night/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.game-night-test-dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test .game-night-test-dist/*.test.mjs; status=$?; rm -rf .game-night-test-dist; exit $status
scripts.test:game-night:integration: rm -rf .game-night-integration-test-dist && esbuild src/game-night/persistence.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.game-night-integration-test-dist/persistence.integration.test.cjs && GAME_NIGHT_INTEGRATION=1 node --test .game-night-integration-test-dist/persistence.integration.test.cjs; status=$?; rm -rf .game-night-integration-test-dist; exit $status
